summary: Tested the PMSC 2026 rebrand on backend and frontend. Backend: new pytest file tests/test_pmsc_rebrand.py, 13 of 13 passed. It covers concurso_de and PRAZO; the cadastro, inscrição (with and without lembrete) and pix email builders (PMSC header present, no Pernambuco/PMPE/CBMPE, deadline 16/11/2026 às 23h59, passes _assert_safe_email); _from_name_inscricao returns 'Inscrição Polícia Militar SC'; the Telegram sigla is PMSC; the pmpe.html modal shows 16/11/2026; the pmsc-logo.png asset loads. Frontend: ran the whole flow in the browser: pmpe.html -> Inscreva-se -> termos.html?c=pmpe -> inscricao.html -> dados-inscricao.html -> confirmacao.html -> inscricao-realizada.html -> minhas-inscricoes.html, then opened pagamento-pix.html?cpf=. Every page shows PMSC 2026 and Polícia Militar de Santa Catarina with no Pernambuco/PMPE/CBMPE visible. The cargo dropdown shows only '201 - Soldado (Praça da Polícia Militar QPPM) - R$ 180,00'. The 6 prova cities are the SC ones. The backend saved the cadastro, registration and inscricao (edital PMPE_26, R$ 180,00), and minhas-inscricoes shows PMSC 2026. The PIX page renders with QR code and copia-e-cola. Found 2 functional bugs: UF_PROVA is forced to 'AP' (Amapá), and the homepage card still says 15/11/2026.

minor.issue: Old regression test still expects the PMPE/CBMPE Telegram titles, so it now fails 9 times. This is expected after the rebrand: delete the file or update it to PMSC.
Unused constant 'Governo do Estado de Santa Catarina'. Harmless.

ui_bugs.issue: Line 814 has syncUf(){ uf.value='AP' }, which runs on DOMContentLoaded, on city change and after 300 ms and 1200 ms. It overrides the 'SC' that concurso.js sets. The hidden input also defaults to value='PE' (line 803). Result: the confirmação page shows 'ESTADO DA PROVA: Amapá', and form_data.UF_PROVA='AP' was saved in the cadastros collection (checked in the DB).
The concurso card still says 'Inscrições abertas até 15/11/2026 às 23h59'. It should be 16/11/2026, like the modal and the emails.

issues: The edital-card header is text only, with no PMSC brasão img (no data-c-src='logo'). pagamento-pix, inscricao-realizada, termos and minhas-inscricoes do show /idcap/img/pmsc-logo.png. The request said the logo should be on every page.

The header repeats 'Polícia Militar de Santa Catarina': the title is 'PMSC - Polícia Militar de Santa Catarina' and the subtitle is 'Polícia Militar de Santa Catarina'. The checkbox and buttons have no data-testid (#termos, #bt-continuar).

action_items: dados-inscricao.html line 814: change uf.value='AP' to 'SC' (or remove syncUf), and change the hidden default value='PE' on line 803 to 'SC'
Optional: add the brasão img (data-c-src='logo') to the edital-card on inscricao, dados-inscricao and confirmacao

Optional: remove the dead cbmpe branches: termos.html D.cbmpe (has 'Corpo de Bombeiros Militar de Pernambuco' in JS), minhas-inscricoes isCbm/'CBMPE 2026', and pagamento-pix/confirmacao CBMPE_26 ternaries
Delete or update the obsolete tests/test_telegram_title_pmpe_cbmpe.py
critical_code_review_comments: The UF_PROVA override is leftover code from an older SEAD/AP clone. It saves the wrong state into the DB.

/cbmpe.html file is deleted, but the server's SPA fallback answers 200 with the React index (title 'IDCAP | SEAD/AP 2026', another stale title), which then sends the user to /inicio.html. So the page cannot be reached, but the status is not a real 404.
minhas-inscricoes still matches /Bombeiro/i to choose the CBMPE label and logo (cbmpe-logo.jpg). Legacy records could show 'CBMPE 2026'.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (flow fully works; UF_PROVA wrong and homepage date stale)
